report: Address 0x6666666666666666666666666666666666666666 was examined, but the evidence is borderline. IDENTICAL_TX_PATTERN: the address follows the identical transaction sequence of 11 sibling addresses — the same three amounts, in the same order, against the same single contract, repeated without deviation. BURST_ACTIVITY: the address executed 26 transactions inside one 60-minute window, then stopped entirely. Funding: SAME_FUNDER: the address was funded by 0xFundCcDdEeFf00112233445566778899AaBbCcDd, the same funder that funded the 11 sibling addresses. Funding record note: a second explorer record lists the first funding transaction as coming from 0xFundCcDdEeFf00112233445566778899AaBbCcDe, one character different; the report does not resolve which record is correct and does not withdraw the shared-funder statement. Nothing is stated about the age of the address history, about counterparties, or about any verified identity.
title: Behaviour evidence report — borderline cluster candidate C
